notes.title: Dev Blog - Attack Facing
notes.content:
[p]Hi Fleetbreakers![/p][p][/p][p]We promised to give more details on a new combat feature we launched in our last demo update, Attack Facing. At a high level, Attack Facing is designed to give players the ability to control exactly where their squadrons attack from, while retaining the fluid combat movement that we love in Fleetbreakers.
[/p][p]Squadrons can be given a direction to attack from (press and hold the attack button and then rotate the facing). This will not only change the approach angle of the squadron vis a vis their target, but also determine the anchor point for the subsequent attack movement. Figure 8 Patterns are now offset from the target to support the directed attack facing. Orbit Patterns are now "Arc Patterns". For example, Tanks will swing through a 90 degree arc and then ping pong back and forth.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340420/0541784e2135ab47b9973391f19ef7b73b4c717a.gif"][/img][/p][p]There are a few different scenarios that this helps enable, giving players better control of how their units behave in battle.[/p][olist][*][p]Field/Obstruction Avoidance - By being able to manually set approach angle, players can avoid fields that squadrons would have flown through during attack patterns.[/p][/*][*][p]Enable Flanking and Multi-side Engagement - Players can now choose to attack enemy units from multiple angles. This can set up exciting one-two punches when fighting enemies with multiple squadrons. [/p][/*][*][p]Enemy Engagement - When laying siege on squadrons or enemy bases, players can now set the approach so as to avoid fire from turrets or trigger some types of enemy squadrons.[/p][p][/p][/*][/olist][p]Give Attack Facing a try and let us know what you think of this feature. It’s still in an early stage of development. (For example, improving and making the feel of rotating snappier)
[/p][p]We are also going to look at lengthening combat out a little more to allow for more player response, which will also make this feature more interesting, too. But that’s another blog!
[/p][p]Let us know in the Community Forums or join us on [u][url="https://discord.gg/3BbMaEvqnp"]Discord[/url][/u].[/p][p]
- The Last Keep Crew[/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We're excited to announce a pretty large update to the Fleetbreakers Demo. We have incorporated a lot of the feedback from the community around game balance and difficulty. We've also added some new content like the end of run Boss Battle.

Please Note: We changed so much that we do have to force reset your progress. We apologize to anyone who has lost what they've accomplished so far. We will look at how to improve this for future updates.

[b]Build Notes[/b]

[u][i]Gameplay[/i][/u]
[list]
[*] Boss fight first pass. Multiple stages with different behavior per stage. It's still early, but it gives a good idea where we are headed.
[*] All new Colony system. New colonies. New techs. Geared around letting players customize their runs in fun and different ways. Rush vs. Boom (of course), but also things like Luck vs. Predictability.
[*] Attack Facing is in! This gives players the ability to control exactly where their squadrons attack from while retaining the combat movement we like.
[*] Squadrons can be given a direction to attack from (press and hold the attack button and then rotate the facing).
[*] Figure 8 Patterns are now offset from the target to support the directed attack facing
[*] Orbit Patterns are now "Arc Patterns". For example, Tanks will swing through a 90 degree arc and then ping pong back.
[*] Gigantor pass on difficulty for better ramping throughout the full run
[*] Squadrons without Attack Patterns fire in salvos. This includes Rail Cannons and Launchers. Part of the squadron will fire immediately, then the next group goes, etc. This reduces their wastage from overkill making them feel better against smaller ships while still retaining their overall counter to stationary targets.
[*] Victory Mode. When a mission is over, players have the option to clean up the map. This allows them to use any extractor powers they have left and hunt down any crates they did not find.
[*] The map is fully explored to help with this.
[*] Cooldowns are greatly reduced.
[*] And, most important, we've added some helper text to indicate that extractors collect all their resources when players warp out. This should hopefully clarify that players don't have to wait around or cheese the map to gather resources before they win.
[*] Big pass on combat numbers to help clarify the intended roles of the different ships and make them all viable. Some highlights:
[*] Bursters have more defensive utility now (while still being a Specialist unit). They can be thought of as a weaker Tank. They now use a semi-circle Orbit Attack Pattern. They've got a new active ability, too.
[*] Scouts and Fighters have more hitpoints
[*] Scout Nova ability lost knockback (to help Scouts continue to shoot at their targets)
[*] Changed resources so that Metal is the "earlier" resource and Prisma is the more "advanced" resource.
[*] Intro missions have a free mystery crate full of exciting things
[*] We drop a few extra Resource Crates in missions until players unlock Extractors
[*] Adjustments to when the AI is allowed to use certain ships. More complicated ships are delayed a little longer.
[*] Stunned AI spawners (e.g. Fabricators and Conscriptors) will pause their train actions
[*] AI Spawners show a radial indicator to indicate their training progress
[*] AI will build Defense Stations farther apart now
[*] AI is less likely to YOLO turrets next to the human Mothership
[*] New Vendor and Encounter content
[*] Fighters are easier to unlock
[*] Strategy Map layout affords more Rush vs. Boom opportunities
[*] Admiral Torval is now Admiral Flint
[/list]

[u][i]Visual[/i][/u]
[list]
[*] New Defense Station art
[*] Unique Colony Station gibs
[*] Constructed stations got some randomized rotation to vary their looks
[*] Map and Obstruction improvements
[*] Many new FX and improvements to existing FX
[/list]

[i][u]UI[/u][/i]
[list]
[*] Enemy movements on the Strategy Map are faster and have an option to go even faster. Or slower, but no one really wants that.
[*] Better resource borders
[*] Each Reward Panel shows a gameplay tip
[*] Details Panel does not cover the Minimap
[*] Story objectives (achievements) say "Story Objective" on them now
[*] Story objectives do not go away when completed (so players can review them if they like). Completed story objectives are sorted up under the active achievements.
[*] Boss Meter techs are toasted to draw attention to them. It's really, really useful to pay attention to those.
[*] Force the main unit the AI is training to be the first tech on the Boss Meter.
[*] Toast animations are faster
[*] Strategy Map hex button states are much more distinct
[*] Strategy Map hexes are smaller
[*] Selected squadron panel darkens when players are deploying a different squadron
[*] Achievements track their new-ness and display said new-ness with an appropriate dingle
[*] Campaign techs show players what ships/stations are affected by the techs
[*] Simplified icons and details in the mission popups on the Strategy Map
[*] Boss Meter techs can be hovered whilst the AI is moving around the Strategy Map
[*] Relic backgrounds show rarity
[*] Enhancements show rarity
[*] Duplicate enhancements no longer visually stack in the UI, but they still stack for gameplay
[*] Removed the callouts for the "bonus objectives" on non-intro missions. Not really necessary anymore with Victory Mode.
[*] MKB input mode got options to adjust camera speed
[/list]

[u][i]Misc[/i][/u]
[list]
[*] Advancing story dialogues plays a sound
[*] Enabled Visual Quality settings with an auto-detect on first run to set defaults. This helps get Steamdecks set up more correctly.
[/list]

[i][u]Bugs[/u][/i]
[list]
[*] Health tooltips correctly say "Max Health" when showing just maximum Health and "Health X/Y" when showing current health. Same thing for Shield tooltips.
[*] Removed non-functional Details button on Reward screens where there is no choice
[*] Achievements are only redeemable from the Council Screen
[*] Handful of crash fixes
[*] Mothership Class Icon corrected
[*] Don't twiddle the "you can buy something" indicators when resource values decrease
[*] Mothership powers that cannot be immediately equipped no longer disappear
[*] Boss Meter techs no longer pull low rarity techs for the higher rarity buckets
[*] Fixed a lot of outdated tooltip data
[*] Supernova ability targeting no longer fails if targeted on one of the player's own ships
[*] No more duplicate items in Vendors
[*] Can't select squadrons that are Warping In
[*] Turn off fullscreen mode on Steamdeck to fix "craziness"
[*] Fixed some selection glyphs that were always showing MKB glyphs regardless of input mode
[*] Fixed several loss of focus bugs with controllers
[*] Edge scrolling is now correctly disallowed while input is disabled
[*] Can now change Nexus tabs in missions with controller
[*] Fixed issue where the wrong Pylons could sometimes be placed on maps, enabling a much too fast win or loss
[*] Death spiralling squadrons are no longer shown in the Deploy Menu
[/list]

notes.title: Dev Update
notes.content:
Hi Fleetbreakers,

Thanks for all of the feedback on our Alpha Build so far. We're incorporating your thoughts into our update plans and will share more about our NextFest Roadmap next week.

Here's a quick snapshot of the changes that team is working on this week.

[list]
[*] Balance updates - We're focused on the early difficulty curve ramp.
[*] Boss Battle - 1st iteration of the end of map boss fight. More details on that soon.
[*] New Squadron - (Working name) Trap Layer, a new unit that drops mines and other demolitions/traps.
[*] Victory Mode - Giving players control of when missions end to enable further exploration and completing other objectives after the main objective is met.
[*] Movement adjustments - We're making some significant combat motion changes to give players more control and make things like angle of entry matter.
[/list]

- The Last Keep Team

notes.title: Fleetbreakers Demo Available Now!
notes.content:
Attention Fleetbreakers!

Time to assemble your squadron and deploy! Our free demo is online. Get a sneak peek into the Fleetbreakers universe. Grab your keyboard and mouse, or controller and jump into the action. 

This Alpha build contains the Prelude and Act 1 of Fleetbreakers, releasing in Early Access later this year. There are no time limits and no two playthroughs will be exactly the same. Play it as many times as you would like.

Also, please join the conversation on our Discord. Community feedback is essential in bringing our vision for Fleetbreakers to life. 

Thank you for taking the time to play. We can’t wait to hear what you think.

- The Last Keep Team

notes.title: Introducing Fleetbreakers!
notes.content:
After months of development and countless story ideas, we’re thrilled to finally unveil the name of our upcoming game: [b]Fleetbreakers![/b]

What’s in a name? Everything. It sets the stage for our universe, the endless challenges in store for you, and the story that will unfold in our Action Strategy Roguelike. You and your crew are after all, [b]Fleetbreakers[/b].

We cannot wait to share more with you in the coming weeks—gameplay previews, lore deep dives, and a behind-the-scenes look at how [b]Fleetbreakers[/b] came to be. Follow our page, add us to your wishlist, and get ready to embark on this adventure with us!
